_comment: The game facts only a play session can settle, from docs/design.md section 7 (Q), docs/plans/emode.md section 5 (E) and the Milestone 10 survey (W1, CM, UC, L1, SC). scripts/game_questions.py gives each a status from the watcher's observation log: open (nothing captured), evidence (captured, but the prompt that read it is untested or the answer needs your eye: settle owner), answered. Set settled_by_doc to where you logged the answer (for example "docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-20") and the question counts as answered. Fields per question: id, source, question, screen, minutes, detector, settle (auto or owner), settled_by_doc. Never put a value read off your screen in this file: it is committed.
